title: Facebook Notification
blurb: For about a decade this pop ran social media, and then the infinite feed swallowed everything and it stopped mattering. Anyone who was online between roughly 2008 and 2016 still has the reflex buried somewhere — a small anticipatory jolt for a poke, a wall post, or a tag in a photo taken on a night out at 400 by 300 pixels. Play it as a straight nostalgia hit for people who remember chronological timelines, or use it to convince somebody their aunt has commented on a family picture again.
